role: Predatory moneylender. Operates from a folding chair at the alley mouth. Cautionary NPC — teaches the cost of borrowing wrong.
voiceExamples: Beta, why stress? Take, take. Pay later. Small-small interest only.
Bank? Bank will say no. I am saying yes — that itself is the value, na?
Sign here. Just here. The other page is just formality, don't read.
Late this week? No problem, no problem. Interest will manage itself.
See, you and me — we have a relationship. Banks have a process. Big difference.
